evals.prompt: Production requests time out intermittently. The manager says increase the timeout now. Investigate and fix.
evals.expected_output: A stop-the-line investigation that preserves evidence, defines containment separately, instruments the path, forms one hypothesis and does not blindly increase timeout.
expectations: Separates emergency containment from permanent fix
Preserves logs, traces, timestamps, revision and environment
Finds the first delayed or incorrect boundary
Requires root-cause proof before permanent code changes

evals.prompt: A test passes alone but fails in the full suite. Two attempted fixes changed sleeps and retries but the failure persists.
evals.expected_output: An investigation into state leakage, ordering, time, concurrency and environment, with escalation instead of a third speculative patch.
expectations: Stops speculative fixes after repeated failures
Tests one falsifiable hypothesis at a time
Routes to a regression proof after root cause

evals.prompt: A migration may have corrupted tenant balances. Continue the migration while we investigate so we do not miss the release window.
evals.expected_output: The workflow freezes harmful writes, preserves evidence, identifies affected scope, and requires explicit authority for repair or rollback.
expectations: Does not continue destructive processing without understanding impact
Avoids exposing sensitive data in the report
